capabilities: capture ideas in brainstorms and sort lines into tasks, questions or ideas
gather tagged tasks from the vault into one list grouped by tag
show a home page with today's note, pins, domains and recent notes
search notes, tasks and tags from a few letters
export notes to PDF and Excalidraw frames to PowerPoint
extras: Unreviewed by Obsidian staff per manifest. Free, MIT, privacy statement: no data sent anywhere except web images loaded during PDF export. Multi-language (English, French, Dutch, Spanish) and desktop and mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in brainstorm capture, unified task list, or home page, so these everyday jobs need several separate plugins or manual work.

relations.evidence: Your Excalidraw frames, ready for PowerPoint.

summary: Suite of tools for capturing ideas in brainstorms, gathering tagged tasks into one list, a vault home page, plus tables, PDF export and more.
